candidates.statement: 12.1 (Geck). The characters within a given ζ-block have the same ζ-defect, so we can speak of the defect of the block itself. Moreover: (1) If the defect is 0, then the block is a singleton. (2) If the defect is 1, then the block is a line of characters ordered by a-value. Its block ideal is isomorphic to a Brauer tree algebra of type A (see below).
candidates.proof_excerpt: This restates Prop. 7.4, Prop. 8.2, and Thm. 9.6 of [G92].

If V is the standard representation of Sn, then the principal block consists of the exterior powers Λi(V), ordered along the line from i = 0 to i = n −1.
